messages.text: Any luck finding an older build
Let me check now.
Searched the web · Hammer DC06 firmware download older version Norn OS
Searched the web · "DC06" miner firmware .bin download 2.0
Found the manufacturer's own repo. Let me look at the release list.
Read github.com/HammerMiner/DC06-APP/releases
Read github.com/HammerMiner/DC06-APP/releases/tag/V3.0.0-20260916
Read github.com/HammerMiner
Releases index is linked now, checking it.
Read github.com/HammerMiner/DC06-APP/releases
Read github.com/HammerMiner/DC06-APP/tags

Here is what I found, and it is a mixed answer.

I went to Hammer's own GitHub for the DC06 (HammerMiner/DC06-APP, the 6 ASIC LTC miner repo). 
The build you are on, V3.0.1 20261012, is there with the note "Optimize mining pool-side algorithm matching"
, which is almost certainly the change that touched the stratum password handling.

What is published for download:
1. V3.0.0 20260916, marked Latest on the releases page, with 3 assets. That is the only older build Hammer has posted publicly.
2. Tags exist for V3.0.1 20260916 and V3.0.1 20261012, but no separate published release with files.
3. There is no 2.x build anywhere on that repo. The pre Norn OS build your screen was running was never published as a public .bin, so I cannot point you at a download for it. I would rather say that plainly than send you to some mirror of unknown origin.

So the only official rollback that exists is V3.0.0 20260916, one step back, still the Norn OS 3.x line. It may or may not carry the same password bug, since the pool-side change landed in 3.0.1. If you want to try it, it is a genuine Hammer file for your exact model, which is the one safety rule that matters. Do one miner only, keep the other two on 3.0.1 so we can compare, and tell me what the Doge page shows after.

The 2.x image itself has to come from Hammer, so I have put that request to JD along with everything we proved today.

Faster route if you want to compare notes with other DC06 owners while that moves: our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD). He is very active there and may have the older image on hand.
Handed to the team · No official DC06 2.x build is published anywhere I can reach; the rollback file
JD has been pinged and can jump into this chat. If you step away, the answer comes to you by email.
I have done that yesterday trying what you just suggested

Good to know, that saves us a step. I need one fact to know where that left you.

After the V3.0.0 20260916 flash yesterday, what does the miner's System or Settings page report as its version now?

1. If it reads V3.0.0 20260916, the downgrade took. Then tell me whether the Doge page listed that rig at any point since.
2. If it still reads V3.0.1 20261012, the flash was refused or rolled back, which is itself a useful finding for JD.

And one thing I want to rule out: when you flashed, was Preserve User Data ticked or unticked? If it was ticked, the old broken password value may have been carried straight across into the new build, and the rollback would look like it changed nothing even though it worked.
I now have all three of my miners on v3.0.1

That is worth pinning down, because it changes what I tell JD.

Which of these happened on the unit you flashed yesterday:

1. You installed V3.0.0 20260916, it came back up reading V3.0.1 anyway, so the downgrade was refused or auto reverted.
2. It did run V3.0.0 for a while, merge mining still did not come back, and you put 3.0.1 back on yourself.

If it is 1, the DC06 is blocking downgrades and there is no rollback path at all without Hammer's help. If it is 2, then V3.0.0 has the same password bug and the fault is older than the 20261012 build, which also tells us something.

Either way your three units are in the same state as before: LTC side fine, Doge side not credited. Nothing you do at the settings page fixes that, so do not spend more time re-pasting the password.
I updated to v3.0.0 first and the merge mining did not work, then I went to v3.0.1 update and got the same results

That settles the diagnosis cleanly. Thank you for doing the 3.0.0 test, it was the right experiment.

What it proves: the doge= tag is not reaching the pool on either 3.0.0 or 3.0.1. So this is not a regression in the 20261012 build, it is the whole Norn OS 3.x line for the DC06. The last build that carried it was the old pre Norn Hammer firmware your screen photo showed. That is exactly what JD needs and I have added it to what is already with him.

Nothing is lost in the meantime: your LTC solo shares are counting normally on all three.

One workaround worth trying while Hammer is on it, because it sidesteps the password field entirely. Some pools let you register the DOGE payout address against your account or LTC address on their side, instead of reading it from each share. If letsmine.it does that, the tag in the password stops mattering.

So: open a ticket or Telegram message with letsmine.it and ask them one question. Can the DOGE merge address be set per account on the pool side, rather than in the stratum password, because my miner firmware is not passing the password through. Tell me what they answer and I will set the miners up to match.

And for a faster read, DC06 owners on our Discord may already have a working trick: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD).
I’ll give that a try as well

Sounds good. Come back here with whatever letsmine.it say and we pick it up from there.

Where things stand, so nothing gets lost:

1. All three DC06 are healthy, hashing around 330 to 350 MH/s, LTC shares accepted.
2. The doge= tag in the stratum password is not going out on V3.0.0 or V3.0.1, which you proved by testing both. Firmware side, not your settings.
3. That is with JD, with your build, pool and config.
4. Open question with the pool: can they hold the DOGE merge address account side instead.

Leave the miners running as they are, no more re-pasting needed.
